checks: The default-off nord2wifibasic argument adds no metadata decode, report, owner admission or backend call when absent. The continuation executes synchronously on the existing retained capability worker after its complete report and before its original parking loop; it starts no second worker.

Preparation revalidates the actual retained capability frame with the canonical parser and derives resource version 0x80000001 from that decoded result. Exact cap/init/firmware pointers, completed CAP receipt, clean transport at completed 4 and actual FW_READY are required. Missing prerequisites skip before any backend callback, resource debit or publication.

The actual existing nwfn_owner policy gains only a completed-4 late ENA29 allowance under the new predicate. Its default macro is false. The predicate binds the real static native object, active current worker, nonparked lifetime, exact CAP/init/firmware objects, prepared one-command state, indices, sequence and inflight/debit state. It does not use a generic completed>=4 bypass. GIC, ownership, guard and pending STA29 checks remain intact.

A pure copied plan or prepared state does not grant authority: a direct clone run fails through the real owner. The same worker and static lease are required for every native callback. Completed 5 closes the lease before any further backend callback.

BASIC_CONFIG remains exactly 76 bytes, CID2 set/no-response, assert options zero, with no MAC field. The proposed pure primitives contain no unused address, NVRAM or domain builders. Board MAC metadata is not a CID2 prerequisite and the README explicitly supersedes that suggestion in the earlier resources package.

AXI TC4 accounting reserves exactly one PSE credit and zero PLE credits after command/descriptor staging and immediately before the single CIDX callback attempt. No retry or refund exists on callback failure, publication uncertainty or DDONE. A publication count records an actual callback attempt, not proven device acceptance.

Success requires DIDX next plus a supported exact DDONE descriptor form. No RX command-result ACK is fabricated or awaited. Completion advances exactly 4 to 5 and then parks. Readiness for networking, regulatory work or later initialization is not claimed.

The 3-second monotonic deadline, 3000-poll bound and 16-debug-event bound are enforced. Debug acceptance matches existing source policy: strict outer class, E000 inner type, EID27, ASCII type 3 and owned extent. Declared lengths and sequence remain captured metadata. Malformed or unknown RX is not rearmed. Only a bounded last header and metadata are printed, without debug body or MAC bytes.

Any run failure sets common native/init/transport/firmware halt flags before captured-only reporting, followed by the existing actual 30-second scheduler drain and panic. Failed callbacks have no later callback, retry, refund or completed-5 transition.

Generator registration, guarded source copies and generated sweet_touch forward declaration/macro scope were inspected. Existing shared native/init/transport/capability ABI sizes remain 7472/3040/1176/5152. Selected Android source anchors and frozen candidate files were independently hash-verified.
verification: Independently compiled and ran both final author suites with ASan/UBSan failfast in temporary outputs, suppressing the frozen log rewrite. Successful debug consumed index 4, rearmed once, completed 5 and refused replay without MMIO.

All frozen manifest files were rechecked unchanged after final verification.
